core_obligations: Compute one side (proof lines 2864-2878): the pullback along the diagonal is the cup product, and the class of the diagonal is the pushforward of the unit, so pairing it with a product of two classes gives the pairing of those two classes on the scheme.

Expand the other side (proof lines 2878-2892): pairing the Kunneth decomposition of the class of the diagonal with a product of classes and using the multiplicativity of the degree map under products gives a sum of products of pairings of the components against the two classes, with the sign one.

Conclude (proof lines 2892-2899): choosing a class dual to a fixed component with respect to the pairing and orthogonal to all others identifies the complementary Kunneth component as that dual class, which yields the displayed orthogonality with the sign.
proof_roadmap: Identify the class of the diagonal with the pushforward of the unit.
Pair the Kunneth decomposition with a product of classes using multiplicativity.
Choose a dual class to read off the asserted pairings.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the Kunneth components of the class of the diagonal pair to plus or minus the Kronecker symbol (statement lines 2860-2873). The proof (proof lines 2874-2899) identifies the class of the diagonal as the pushforward of the unit, expands its Kunneth decomposition, and computes the pairings through the multiplicativity of the degree map. H3: a computation with an explicit choice of dual class, written out in full.
